description: This file defines a class named HTMLPurifier_Filter, which represents a filter used in the HTML Purifier library for pre- and post-processing of HTML content. The class includes properties and methods for managing filter behavior, such as preFilter and postFilter, which handle HTML before and after purification, respectively.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Filter
classes.description: Represents a pre or post processing filter on HTML Purifier's output

methods.name: preFilter
methods.description: Handles HTML before HTML Purifier processing; designed to be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: postFilter
methods.description: Handles HTML after HTML Purifier processing; designed to be overridden by subclasses.
